errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the category axis as the horizontal axis, but it is the vertical axis.
The description incorrectly identifies the value axis as the vertical axis, but it is the horizontal axis.
The description incorrectly states that each tick mark represents 10%, but the labeled tick marks on the x-axis are at intervals of 20%.

errors.text_span: 在“激活”方面，最高的百分比接近100%（宣传学习）
errors.evidence: The category with the highest '激活' (activation) percentage is '积极参与' (Active Participation) at exactly 100%, not '宣传学习' (Promotion and Learning) which is at approximately 90%.

The category with the lowest '激活' (activation) percentage is '个人卫生' (Personal Hygiene) at 0%. Among those with non-zero activation, '遵守秩序' (Observing Order) is the lowest at ~5%, while '穿着服饰' (Dressing) is ~15%.
The '抑制' (inhibition) percentage for '积极参与' (Active Participation) is 0%, not 70%.

errors.text_span: 其他类别的百分比均接近95%或更高
errors.evidence: This is a significant over-generalization. The '抑制' (inhibition) percentages for other categories vary widely, including values around 10% ('宣传学习'), 35% ('爱护环境'), 65% ('爱护公物'), and 75% ('用语礼貌').
